But my wallet's light
My hands are cold

The laps I swim won’t buy her cheer

Easter’s joy slips through my grasp
I’ll trade the gold for skies of blue

But she deserves the sugar land
I’m swimming for a future bright
But Easter fades in neon light

[Chorus]
Broke for the dreams I chased too fast
Easter’s joy slips through my grasp
I’ll trade the gold for skies of blue
But wish I had the eggs for you

Verse 1)
I used to go away for Easter every single year
Whole weekend felt like magic, disappear without a care
Hangin’ in the hall at the radio convention
Two minutes to the fox hunt, heart beatin’ with intention
Lollies in the guessing contests, laughin’ till we cried
Watchin’ mum and dad scramble, pushin’ through the tide
Over maps and where we go, arguin’ with a grin
It was less scary back then, before the world kicked in
(Chorus)
Hehe, well Easter Saturday then
Yes hun, those were the days my friend
Fox hunts and scrambles, lollies on the floor
Whole weekend felt like Easter, knockin’ at the door
Now I miss those times, the chaos and the fun
Wish I could go back again, under that Easter sun
(Verse 2)
Mum and dad fightin’ over directions on the map
Laughin’ in the backseat, never worried ‘bout the trap
Radio voices callin’, contests fill the air
Two-minute warnings ringin’, excitement everywhere
It felt like forever, that hall was our whole world
No phones, no worries, just the scramble and the swirl
Less scary in the moment, with family by my side
Now the memories linger, on this quiet Easter tide
(Bridge – slower)
Hehe and a smile, two minutes on the clock
Yes hun, those simple days stretch across the miles
Lollies and the laughter, the fights that turned to jokes
Whole weekend felt like Easter, wrapped in family folks
(Final Chorus – building gently)
Hehe, well Easter Saturday then
Yes hun, I’d give anything to go again
Fox hunts and scrambles, mum and dad in the fray
Whole weekend felt like Easter, in the good old way
I miss those times, the hall, the maps, the fun
One more Easter weekend… under that rising sun
(Outro – fading)
Lol…
It was less scary back then…
Whole weekend felt like Easter…

### ☕💋 **EASY, FLIRTY COFFEEBREAK** 🎷

Your hands find mine,
Our fingers tangle,
You stay a second too long,
Then you’re right here next to me.
Sounds like the seed of a sweet, cheeky **CoffeeBreak-style country song** 🍓🍬☕️

**“Love Candy”**

Love candy, sweet strawberries,
Red lips dancing underneath the moon,
Sugar on the table, laughter in the air,
You pull me closer and I’m going somewhere soon.
Absolutely. Let’s turn those into the darker, rainy side of the love-candy story. 🌧️🍓

**LOVE CANDY**

Love candy, sweet strawberries,
Wine-red skies and memories,
Then the tears came pouring down,
Like heavy rain all over town.

We complain, we fight, we say goodbye,
Then miss each other by midnight,
Sweet little moments, bitter little lies,
Love keeps falling from those rainy skies.

**Tears and rain, rain and tears,
All the things we swallowed through the years,
Strawberry sweetness turned to pain,
Love tastes different in the pouring rain.**

If you want, I can make it **more country, more heartbreaking, or turn it into a big singalong chorus**. 🎸🌧️

Strawberry kisses, sparkling wine,
Two little hearts getting tangled up in time,
Pink skies fading, stars coming through,
Love tastes sweeter when I’m sharing it with you.

**Oh, love candy, strawberry sweet,
Got my heart skipping to a country beat,
Pour a little sunshine, turn the music up,
Tonight’s got sugar running through our cups.**

You grin, I tease,
You move, I sway,
Satin catching in the kitchen,
Coffee cooling off to play.

**Easy, easy, CoffeeBreak,**
Come a little closer, darling,
Easy, easy, don’t be shy,
I can see that spark inside.

Heartbeat, heartbeat,
Keep it slow,
Caramel latte steaming,
Candlelight on the stove.

Your eyes catch mine,
I glance away,
Then you catch me looking back,
And we both start to sway.

**Easy, easy, CoffeeBreak,**
Sweet like chocolate cake,
Strawberries and cream,
A little midnight shake.

Don’t rush it now,
Let it hang, let it stay,
One small smile, one small touch,
And we’re moving anyway.

**Easy, easy, CoffeeBreak,**
Satin, sparkle, moonlit glow,
You and me, a vintage scene,
Dancing nice and slow. ☕🎷✨

Even the dog died of cancer I’m really sorry you’re carrying this much. Here’s a song shaped from what you wrote — sad, but strong and honest.

⸻

Verse 1
Hospital lights and waiting room air
Coffee gone cold in a plastic chair
Names on charts that we never read right
Learning new words in the middle of night

Every phone call feels heavy to hold
Every “we’ll see” feels painfully cold
We count time in scans and in sighs
Try to stay brave while the bravest one cries

Pre-Chorus
How can the world keep turning like this
While ours stands still in a moment we miss

Chorus
Mum has tumors, Dad has cancer
We keep praying for an answer
Mum beat cancer once before
Now we’re knocking on that door

Kelly’s heart is tired and worn
Breathing feels like glass and thorns
Even the dog we loved so much
Lost the fight we couldn’t touch

But we’re still here, holding tight
In the darkest kind of night
If love could heal, if love could save
We’d build a miracle from the brave

Verse 2
Photos stacked in the hallway frame
Smiles from years before the pain
Laughing at jokes we can’t tell now
Wondering when and wondering how

We learn strength we never asked for
Find hope hiding in the floor
Of the cracks that life leaves behind
Tiny lights we’re trying to find

Pre-Chorus
Somehow the sun still rises again
Even on days we don’t know when

Chorus
Mum has tumors, Dad has cancer
We keep praying for an answer
Mum beat cancer once before
So we believe she can once more

Kelly’s heart is tired and worn
Breathing feels like glass and thorns
Even the dog we held so near
Left a silence ringing here

But we’re still here, hand in hand
Trying hard to understand
If love could heal, if love could save
We’d build a miracle from the brave

Bridge
Maybe hope is quiet and small
Maybe it whispers, that’s all
Maybe it lives in every hug
Every “I’m here,” every “don’t give up”

We bend, we break, we cry, we pray
But we wake up and face the day

Final Chorus
Mum has tumors, Dad has cancer
Still we’re searching for an answer
We’ve seen miracles before
So we believe in them once more

Hearts still beat and lungs still fight
We hold on with all our might
Through every tear, through every wave
We keep building life from the brave

Outro
Hospital lights fade into dawn
Somehow the love keeps carrying on. 💛

# **Faith Above the Stars**

**Verse 1**
Coffee mornings, golden skies,
A little hope in every sunrise.
Strawberries sweet and dreams come true,
A grateful heart keeps shining through.

Chocolate rivers, moonlit nights,
Love and laughter, candlelight.
Through every storm, through every mile,
God’s love carries me with a smile.

**Pre-Chorus**
When the waves are high and the road gets long,
I find my courage in a heavenly song.
A quiet prayer, a guiding flame,
A loving hand that calls my name.

**Chorus**
Faith in God above, shining like a star,
Guiding every dream no matter where we are.
With a heart full of love and a soul set free,
His light keeps glowing inside of me.

Strawberries and cream, sweet memories,
A little bit of magic carried on the breeze.
Through every joy and everything I’ve been through,
I hold onto faith, and I hold onto truth.

**Verse 2**
Whispers of angels in the morning air,
A reminder that I’m never alone in my prayers.
The world keeps turning, the seasons change,
But heaven’s love will still remain.

**Bridge**
So I’ll sing my song beneath the sky,
With hope in my heart and dreams that fly.
Every heartbeat, every new start,
God’s love is written across my heart.
Wierd LadyPound PuppyMixed Emotions
**Final Chorus**
Faith in God above, brighter than the sun,
A beautiful journey has only begun.
With love as my rhythm and grace as my guide,
I’ll walk through this world with heaven beside.

**Outro**
Coffee cups, morning light,
Stars that sparkle through the night.
Love and faith forever shine,
A little piece of heaven in this heart of mine. ☕✨

# **FIREPROOF HEART: THE PRAYER ❤️‍🔥🙏**

**[Intro Prayer]**
God, I'm laying down my pride,
Everything I've tried to hide.
Take this heart that's tired and bruised,
Teach me how to love and choose.

If I've been selfish, make me new,
If I've been angry, pull me through.
Give me patience when I'm afraid,
Give me courage when love starts to fade.

**[Verse 1: Surrender]**
I can't control another heart,
I can't force what falls apart.
So I surrender what I can't change,
Put my worries in Your hands again.

Give me wisdom before I speak,
Give me strength when I feel weak.
Help me listen, help me see,
The person I need to change is me.

**[Pre-Chorus: Repentance]**
Forgive the words I shouldn't have said,
Forgive the battles inside my head.
Wash away resentment and blame,
Teach me to love without keeping score.

**[Chorus: Fireproof]**
Make my heart **FIREPROOF**,
When the flames rise higher,
Give me faith when I'm frightened,
Give me love when I'm tired.

Protect what is worth saving,
Heal what has been torn,
Let forgiveness be the water
When our hearts are burning.

Make my heart **FIREPROOF**,
Keep me humble, keep me true,
God, if love is worth rebuilding,
Teach me what I'm called to do.

**[Verse 2: Forgiveness]**
Help me forgive what hurt me,
Help me release yesterday.
Not pretending nothing happened,
But refusing hate to have its way.

Take the bitterness from my soul,
Make the broken pieces whole.
Help me apologize when I'm wrong,
And give me grace to carry on.

**[Verse 3: Patience & Kindness]**
Give me patience when I'm frustrated,
Kindness when I'm aggravated.
Help me speak with gentle grace,
Instead of throwing blame in your face.

Let my actions speak much louder,
Let my love become much prouder.
Not proud of winning every fight,
But proud of choosing what is right.

**[Bridge: Protection Prayer]**
God, protect our hearts from anger,
Protect our minds from fear.
Protect us from temptation,
And bring what matters near.

Give us wisdom, give us peace,
Let resentment finally cease.
Where there's distance, build a bridge,
Where there's darkness, light the ridge.

And if we're lost, show us the way,
Give us courage for another day.
If we've forgotten why we began,
Remind us of Your greater plan.

**[Big Prayer Build]**
I pray for healing.
I pray for grace.
I pray for courage
When I can't see Your face.

I pray for patience.
I pray for truth.
I pray for wisdom
In everything I do.

I pray for forgiveness.
I pray for peace.
I pray the anger
And resentment cease.

I pray for humility.
I pray for trust.
Teach us that love
Is more than lust.

**[Final Chorus]**
Make our hearts **FIREPROOF**,
When the whole world burns around us,
Let our faith become the shelter,
Let Your mercy surround us.

No perfect fairytale,
No promise life won't bruise,
Just two imperfect hearts
Learning how to choose.

Make our hearts **FIREPROOF**,
Give us strength to start again.
Where there once was anger,
Let forgiveness enter in.

And if love is worth protecting,
Give us courage to fight true,
Not against each other,
But for the love we choose.

**[Outro Prayer]**
God, take my heart.
Take my anger.
Take my fear.
Take my pride.

Teach me to love with patience.
Teach me to forgive with grace.
Teach me to serve without expecting something back.

And whatever happens next,
Help me become someone who loves better.

First partner at 19,  
he kissed me, thought he was a bit too sleazy

he told people that we broke up, crazy  

Chocolate with a squeeze of citrus, velvet with a wink  
Loving my big wife hips, kissing me quick like pickup sticks  

[Verse 1]  
He tastes like midnight melted slow  
Cocoa words in a gentle flow  
“ You okay?” like warm rain falls  
Wraps me up in caramel walls  

First partner at 19,  
met up later, blurred that line  
Friends with benefits, whisky nights,  
sex on the beach and city lights  

Protection on, we chased that thrill,  
laughing loud, we drank our fill  
But in the dark, in motel sheets,  
life slipped away between the beats  

[Pre-Chorus]  
He’s velvet voice and careful hands  
Drawing maps before he lands  
Sugar steady, citrus bright  
Soft by day, sharp by night  

But there’s a twist beneath the sweet,  
a little lime in every beat  
He’ll kiss my forehead, smooth my hair,  
then ask what future’s waiting there  

[Chorus]  
He’s chocolate sweet with a sour spark  
Golden honey with a question mark  
Checks my pulse, steadies my spin  
But won’t dive deep till he’s sure he can swim  

Cocoa heat with a lemon line,  
bittersweet and mostly mine  
If I’m sugar rushing through the dark,  
he’s the tart that wakes my heart  

[Verse 2 – Blend]  
First partner at 19, thought it was fun,  
whisky sex till the rising sun  
Protection used, but something leaked,  
I bled in silence, couldn’t speak  

Pretty sure I lost a piece  
of some unborn, fragile peace  
No vows, no ring, no family tree,  
just a ghost where a heart could be  

He doesn’t drown in fantasy,  
he builds a bridge to get to me  
Says I’m fire, says I shine,  
but tastes the edges of every line  

[Bridge]  
Sweet on my tongue, slow on the trust  
Silk and citrus, careful lust  
He’s dessert that makes you think,  
dark rich love with a playful kink  

Miscarriage pain I never named,  
he never knew, I never claimed  
Whisky nights and lemon light,  
sweet then sour in the same bite  

[Final Chorus – Drop]  
He’s chocolate sweet with a sour kiss,  
warm as sin but sharp as bliss  
Holds me close, but counts the cost,  
loving me like nothing’s lost  

First partner at 19,  
ghosts in my body, stains unseen  
Cocoa heat with a lemon line,  
I taste the hurt and call it mine  

He’s chocolate sweet with a sour spark,  
golden honey in the broken dark  
If I’m sugar rushing through the past,  
he’s the tart that makes me breathe at last

a quiet name hums like a secret within

eyes on the floor like you owned my oxygen

had a friends-with-benefits thing, so fun

protection used but I had a miscarriage—  
pretty sure, as it leaked  flesh like baby octopus came out didn’t look like a clot to me

till I laughed less, till my voice went silent

pulled my bright clothes off the back of my chair

give it back, give it back, give it back

every silence pulls me nearer

no need for roses to feel what you do,
